name: PdxNumberInput
description:
A number input the user steps by a step, or on the digit before the caret, with a sign toggle
and locale formatting.

members.name: min
members.description: Minimum allowed value.

members.name: max
members.description: Maximum allowed value.

members.name: step
members.description: Increment step.

members.name: precision
members.description: Decimal places to round/format to (-1 = derive from step).

members.name: trimZeros
members.description:
Show only the decimals the value has, up to `precision`: 29.5 at `precision="3"` is
"29.5", not "29.500". The value is still rounded to `precision`, and what the field
emits does not change.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the control as invalid.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder text shown while empty.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

members.name: controls
members.description: 'both'=−left +right, 'right'=stacked on right, 'none'=hidden

members.name: stepMode
members.description:
What the arrow keys and the wheel step. `fixed`: one `step`. `caret`: the digit
before the caret — `12|3` ↑ is 133, `1.2|5` ↑ is 1.35 — and the caret stays on that digit.
`auto`, the default: `caret` with `controls="none"`, `fixed` with steppers shown.

members.name: allowWheel
members.description: Allow the mouse wheel to change the value when focused.

members.name: allowNegative
members.description: Allow negative values (adds a sign toggle).

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale for formatting and for reading a typed value. Empty: the page's language (`lang`), then the browser's.

members.name: currency
members.description: ISO currency code for currency formatting (e.g. EUR).

members.name: colorBySign
members.description: Color the number green (positive) / red (negative)

members.name: loading
members.description: Show loading state

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: value
members.description: The number, or `null` when the field is empty. A form submits it clamped, and resets it (#135).

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to it.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

members.name: selectText
members.description: Select the whole text, so the next keystroke replaces it. Does not focus first.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.
